headline: 118 Dana Avenue lot split and 538 Grove Street porch approved; Millbury Street billboard hearing pushed to December 21
summary: Residents spoke against a digital billboard change at 692 Millbury Street, and that hearing was pushed to December 21. Approval came for splitting 118 Dana Avenue into two lots, though neighbors raised parking and traffic worries. Five other hearings were moved to November 30.
decisions: Continued the hearing on 167 and 177 Southwest Cutoff to November 30, 2026, 5-0.
Postponed hearings for 14 to 18 Clara Drive, 209 Lincoln Street, 195 Mill Street, and 18 Crown Street to November 30, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the hearing on the digital billboard conversion at ROW adjacent to 692 Millbury Street to the December 21 meeting.
Approved a variance for a front porch at 538 Grove Street that sits 2.9 feet into the 20-foot front setback, 5-0.
Approved variances to split 118 Dana Avenue into two lots for new homes, 5-0.
discussion: Millbury Street billboard: Members weighed electricity use, light levels, and how quickly malfunctions would be fixed. Members said they wanted the overnight shutoff kept, which the applicant had asked to remove.

118 Dana Avenue duplex: Residents said the new homes would add parking, traffic, and snow-removal problems. Members said the lot could already add units without asking for relief, and that the plan puts parking in driveways.
Millbury Street quorum: Only four members could vote, so the item was continued. Members said a fifth vote could come if a member files a Mullen affidavit.
538 Grove Street porch: Members said the porch was built before approval, and that the board would likely have granted the variance if asked first.
